lead: An object cannot cross an isolate boundary outward unless it crossed inward first.
body: `Live::admit` compares descriptor addresses, so a `class Node` declared in both parent and child is two descriptors and `return new Node(...)` is `ok=false`. Pass the object in as `args:` and have the child hand it back, as `examples/cycles.nvs` does.

until.arg: crates/nvs-runtime/src/graph.rs:on the receiving side is a different class
